players.product: PCIe Gen6 fabric switches (Scorpio), retimers (Aries), AECs (Torus), CXL memory controllers (Leo) for AI racks

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Desmond Lynch, Q3 2026 outlook (non-GAAP): 'We expect revenue to be in the range of $540 million-$560 million. At the midpoint, this represents 40% sequential growth driven by the transition of Scorpio X-Series to volume production, continued strength in Aries PCIe 6.0 retimers, and pre-production shipments of Taurus solutions supporting 100 gigabits per lane for 800-gigabit Ethernet.' Gross margin approximately 72%; operating expenses between $156 million and $160 million; operating margin approximately 43%, up 400 basis points sequentially; interest and other income approximately $12 million; tax rate approximately 12%; diluted share count approximately 185 million; EPS between $1.16 and $1.21. CFO on margins: the main impacts are 'silicon versus module revenue mix and the different use cases associated with our switching portfolio', and 'I would expect our gross margins continue to trend towards a long-term target of 70% from here.'
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 revenue $540M-$560M (40% sequential growth at midpoint); GM ~72%; op margin ~43%; EPS $1.16-$1.21

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Desmond Lynch, Q2 2026 non-GAAP detail: operating expenses $135.8 million, up 10% sequentially, 'reflecting continued investment in our roadmap'; interest and other income $12.1 million; tax rate 12%; net income $145.8 million; diluted EPS $0.80, 'an increase of more than 30% from Q1'; cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaling $1.25 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 opex $135.8M (+10% QoQ); net income $145.8M; EPS $0.80 (+30%+ QoQ); cash and securities $1.25B

quarterly_data.signal: Product-line trajectory (call): CFO — Aries delivered record quarterly revenue in Q2 and 'remained our largest product line', and 'I do expect Aries to continue to grow in Q3 and beyond'; Scorpio becomes the largest product line in Q3 on the production ramp of the high-radix solutions. President/COO Sanjay Gajendra — 'We do expect Q3 at least for our lead opportunity and lead customer to ramp to high-volume production in Q3 and essentially taking over, or surpassing the revenue from Scorpio P-Series'; Scorpio X expected to ship to revenue for additional customers by end of year. CEO Jitendra Mohan — Scorpio P-Series had new shipments to hyperscalers and AI infrastructure providers; 'These programs are currently in pre-production and are expected to ramp more meaningfully in 2027'; Sanjay: over the long term the company aims to proliferate Scorpio P-Series into modular AI servers, disaggregated KV cache appliances, storage platforms and enterprise-level servers. Taurus — CFO expects further Q3 growth 'driven by the strong base of the 400 gig demand, as well as the early contributions of 800 gigs'; CEO expects H2 growth as 800G deployments expand, 'driving improved attach rates and higher ASPs compared to 400G solutions'; Sanjay: 1.6T and 3.2T-based systems drive Taurus over the long term. Leo CXL — CFO: 'we continue to see some revenue here in the back half of the year, which will ramp more materially into 2027'; Sanjay: multiple CXL design wins and opportunities, 'most of them in qualification or early stage this year and getting into high-volume production in 2027.'
quarterly_data.figure: Aries largest line in Q2; Scorpio X surpasses Scorpio P revenue at lead customer in Q3; Scorpio P and Leo CXL ramp 2027; Taurus 400G base + early 800G

quarterly_data.signal: Aries drivers (call): CEO Jitendra Mohan — Aries growth is fueled by 'increased AI system deployments, expanding AI accelerator cluster sizes, greater unit attach rates, and higher ASPs associated with the transition to PCIe 6'. President/COO Sanjay Gajendra — Aries 5 'definitely continues to expand', with inference-based applications 'driving a new wave of growth'; Aries 6 supports 64 gigabits per second and 'comes in with higher attach rate and going into several new platforms', plus cabled applications; 'the surprise is how long Gen 5 has continued'. CEO: 'we expect this trend to continue as new Gen 6 platforms and GPUs are being developed ... Then, of course, then we move on to Gen 7. You can expect some of this cycle to continue for a long time.'
quarterly_data.figure: Aries 6 at 64 Gbps with higher attach; Gen 5 extended by inference; cycle continues to Gen 7

quarterly_data.signal: Deployment breadth (call): CEO Jitendra Mohan — the Scorpio X chip 'supports both liquid cooling and air cooling. In fact, we do have customers that are designing it for both of them'; 'We do see this increasing use case of enterprise customers and neo-clouds looking at solutions that are based on Scorpio as a scale-up and using add-in card form factor GPUs to deliver good inferencing TCO', sometimes without building a full rack-level solution. CEO on UALink: new IP vendors and tools are coming online and other vendors have announced products — 'a nice, vibrant ecosystem'. President/COO Sanjay Gajendra on optics: the company has teams on the EIC and on silicon photonics and 'late last year, we acquired aiXscale Photonics, which gives us the ability to develop a connector'; 'we expect that the first deployment will happen with NPO solution'. Custom silicon: 'We are also engaged with multiple customers on additional high-value custom connectivity opportunities to deliver end-to-end purpose-built silicon solutions.'
